create_PerfTimer: create a PerfTimer instance to measure elapsed time of code blocks with optional CUDA event tracking
create_PerfStats: create a PerfStats object to accumulate timing metrics from multiple PerfTimer instances across iterations
create_PerfMetric: create a PerfMetric instance to track numerical metrics with EMA smoothing and running averages
run_PerfTimer_context: run timed code blocks using PerfTimer as a context manager to record host and CUDA execution times
summarize_PerfStats_report: summarize accumulated performance statistics by calling report_str to print a column-aligned timing report
